papers.summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has demonstrated significant gains in image captioning, yet it is still limited in encouraging Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to explore novel reasoning strategies. papers.summary: Behaviour Cloning (BC) has driven remarkable progress in robot manipulation, yet it is fundamentally limited by its inability to self-improve: a policy that fails cannot learn from that failure without additional human demonstrations. papers.title: SRL-MPC: Shape-Aware Reinforcement Learned Model Predictive Control
papers.summary: Safe and efficient shape-aware navigation in heterogeneous crowds and robot fleets remains challenging. papers.summary: Agents learn to act through interaction with environments, yet the environments used for training are often manually constructed or synthesized around predefined tasks and benchmarks.
